    (p : P ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj F)
    [P.IsStrictlyLE 0] [QuasiIso p]

title: H-zero of a nonpositive termwise-flat tensor model
statement: Let C be a braided closed monoidal abelian category with monoidal additivity. Let F,G be objects of C, P an integer cochain complex strictly supported in degrees ≤0, and p:P→F[0] a quasi-isomorphism. Assume every P^i is flat. Then the termwise tensor-with-G map induced by p is an isomorphism on degree-zero homology.

source.place: Derived tensor flat-model construction; degree-zero cokernel calculation by right exactness

proof.text: For a strictly nonpositive complex, H-zero is the cokernel of the differential from degree -1 to degree 0. The quasi-isomorphism p identifies this cokernel with F. Tensor with G preserves cokernels because it is a left adjoint. Thus the termwise tensor map induced by p is invertible on H-zero. This statement is about the model only; canonical derived transport is the separate canonical-identification node.
